title: Slider
description: Single-value range on a hairline track with a filled or hollow thumb, plus optional ticks

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label linked to the native range input.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Optional displayed value text; does not set or change the native input value.

props.name: hollow
props.description: Use the hollow thumb treatment; defaults to false.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Optional positive finite tick subdivision count, rounded down. Omitted or invalid values hide the tick decoration.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes on the label/range wrapper. className, ref, value, min, max, step and onChange target the native range input.
